newsitem.title: USA: Bank of New York Co Inc Q2 diluted shr rises.
newsitem.headline: Bank of New York Co Inc Q2 diluted shr rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Yr-ago results exclude sale of Union portfolio credit card business.
Yr ago Q2 had net gain $31 million, or $0.07 shr, on sale of credit card business.
Q2 non-interest income $489 million vs $842 million, with yr-ago including sale of credit card portfolio.
Q2 net interest income $489 million vs $502 million.
At June 30, Tier I capital ratio 7.83 pct vs 7.98 pct.
Q2 net credit cards loan chargeoffs $88 million vs $187. Yr ago includes $99 million from Union credit card accounts not sold to Household.
At June 30, assets $61.58 bln vs $51.46 bln.
